money.transfer.label: Money transfer
money.transfer.description: An action that moves funds -- dispatching a payment, initiating a transfer, or otherwise committing money to move. Seeded by the payments-safety starter pack (asg/payments-safety/1.0.0).

_provenance.source: action-state-group/capsule-emit-mesh (plugins/admission-policy/src/capsule_emit.rs, capsule_sidecar.py) via the CPB provisional payload class 'mesh-inference-exchange' (action-state-group/scitt-payload-binding@c5e0435, spec/cpb-provisional-registry.md)
_provenance.note: Vendored, provisional field-value labels for the mesh-inference-exchange payload class. These are the AAC six-registry values that class's producer sets on the surrounding capsule; they are known-with-status-provisional (resolved by agent_action_capsule.verify check 8 against the vendored CPB provisional snapshot), never a rejection. Refresh with scripts/vendor_cpb_registry.py.

inference_completion.label: Inference completion
inference_completion.description: A model inference the record attests as completed. Set by the mesh-inference-exchange provisional payload class.

host_served_observed.label: Host-served, observed
host_served_observed.description: The effect was observed by the serving host at the wire (passive collector vantage), not asserted by a gate. Set by the mesh-inference-exchange provisional payload class.

follows.label: Follows
follows.description: Same-node sequential ordering: this record follows the prior record in a node-run chain. Emitted by the mesh capsule-producer plugin. Set by the mesh-inference-exchange provisional payload class.

_provenance.source: ldg-grc-folds-batch (2026-09-05), hand-authored for the eu-ai-act obligations pack.

Additive only; the never-reject invariant applies here too: an unregistered value renders as-is.
_provenance.provisional_note: [grc-facets-upstream-registry-proposals]: this whole table is a vendored, engine-local copy, not the registry of record -- the eight GRC facets here are staged for upstream registration at action-state-group/scitt-payload-binding per H.4 (facet values are substrate). Provisional at the TABLE level until the upstream entries land; each entry's own "status" (registered/planned) is unrelated ENGINE-internal wiring state, not an upstream registration state.

ai.label: AI-interaction disclosure
ai.description: Art 50(1): the person was informed they are interacting with an AI system.

emotion.label: Emotion-recognition disclosure
emotion.description: Art 50(3): the person was informed emotion-recognition is in use.

biometric.label: Biometric-categorisation disclosure
biometric.description: Art 50(3): the person was informed biometric categorisation is in use.

standard.label: Standard serious incident
standard.description: Art 73(2): reported within 15 days of awareness.

death.label: Incident involving death
death.description: Art 73(2): reported within 10 days of awareness.

widespread_or_critical.label: Widespread infringement or critical-infrastructure incident
widespread_or_critical.description: Art 73(2): reported within 2 days of awareness.

text.label: Text
text.description: AI-generated or manipulated text output (Art 50(2) marking).

image.label: Image
image.description: AI-generated or manipulated image output (Art 50(2) marking).

audio.label: Audio
audio.description: AI-generated or manipulated audio output (Art 50(2) marking).

video.label: Video
video.description: AI-generated or manipulated video output (Art 50(2) marking).

directed.label: Directed
directed.description: The action was taken on an explicit human instruction. Human-oversight coverage fold facet (Art 14(3)).

responsive.label: Responsive
responsive.description: The action was taken in response to an environmental/tool event, not a standing instruction. Human-oversight coverage fold facet (Art 14(3)).

discovered.label: Discovered
discovered.description: The action was taken on the agent's own initiative, with no immediate human or environmental trigger. Human-oversight coverage fold facet (Art 14(3)).

user_provided.label: User-provided
user_provided.description: Input supplied directly by the human principal.

tool_output.label: Tool output
tool_output.description: Input produced by a tool call the agent invoked.

retrieved_context.label: Retrieved context
retrieved_context.description: Input retrieved from a document/knowledge store, not authored live.

model_generated.label: Model-generated
model_generated.description: Input produced by a prior model generation (e.g. a planning step feeding an execution step).

supersedes.label: Supersedes
supersedes.description: This record overrides/stops a prior record it cites -- the override relation the GRC folds batch's facets rely on (distinct from the vendored mesh 'follows' relation above).

_provenance.note: Bare identifier/reference fields with no enumerable value set -- registered here so their presence is documented, without forcing them into a value-label table they don't need.
_provenance.provisional_note: [grc-facets-upstream-registry-proposals]: staged for upstream registration at action-state-group/scitt-payload-binding alongside grc_field_conventions -- see that table's provisional_note. Provisional at the TABLE level until the upstream entries land.

grc_reference_fields.approver_id: Identifies the human approver of an action -- read by the set-membership fold (folds/set_membership.py, EU-26-2) against a roster.
grc_reference_fields.output.marking_ref: Cites the AI-generated-content marking artifact for an output.media_class row (Art 50(2)) -- pairs with output.media_class above.
grc_reference_fields.reference_db_ref: Cites the EU database registration receipt (Art 49) by digest.
